subject: Technical deep dive: integration & network architecture (Cypher Analytics) - postmortem & reschedule
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Talia Brooks <talia@cypheranalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Technical deep dive: integration & network architecture (Cypher Analytics)

Hi Talia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the integration flow you described lined up well with what our serving runtime can optimize. Per our conversation, we'd like to block 60 minutes for a technical deep dive focused on network architecture, authentication flows, and token/km configurations so our engineers can surface any blockers before a pilots decision.

Proposed slot: Friday, Aug 14 • 11:00–12:00 PT
If that doesn't work, I can also do Mon 8/17 10:00–11:00 PT or Tue 8/18 14:00–15:00 PT.

Attached: deep-dive-agenda-v2.pdf (high-level agenda) and network-outline.png (example VPC diagram we typically ask customers to review).

Agenda highlights:
- 15m: Architecture walkthrough (Cypher)
- 25m: Redwood runtime + network/KMS checklist (Marcus + Grace)
- 20m: Q&A and pilot next steps

Please let me know which slot works and whether to invite any additional folks from your security or infra teams.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: deep-dive-agenda-v2.pdf (application/pdf), network-outline.png (image/png)

Vanessa —

I am so sorry — we had an incident this morning that pulled in the execs and I completely missed the 11am slot. I know Marcus and Grace had prepared follow-up items and I'm embarrassed to have left you hanging.

Can we please reschedule? My calendar is a bit messy this week but I can do any of these: Mon 8/17 10am PT, Tue 8/18 2pm PT, or Wed 8/19 after 1pm PT.

Also cc'ing Samir (ops) — he should join for the network/KMS discussion.

Apologies again,
Talia Brooks

Subject: Re: Technical deep dive: integration & network architecture (Cypher Analytics) — proposed next steps

Hi Talia —

No worries — thanks for the note and for looping Samir in. Sorry we missed each other today. Quick recap and proposal:

1) What happened: Your team hit an exec incident this morning and were pulled into an all-hands. We understand — these things happen.
2) Quick postmortem (attached): postmortem-notes.txt — confirms no action required on our side and lists the artifacts Marcus/Grace planned to present.
3) Reschedule options (please pick one):
   • Mon 8/17 • 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred by Vanessa + Marcus)
   • Tue 8/18 • 14:00–15:00 PT (Grace prefers this)
   • Wed 8/19 • 13:00–14:00 PT

If none of the above work, send a few times and we'll mirror to your timezone. We'll include a short 10–15 minute pre-call to verify firewall/VPC peering and KMS access.

Marcus and Grace — can you confirm you'll cover runtime networking, token exchange patterns, and our recommended KMS/HSM flow?

Attachment: postmortem-notes.txt (plain text) — brief notes + list of artifacts we asked Cypher to share ahead of the call.

Thanks — we'll drop calendar invites as soon as Talia confirms a slot.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Hi all —

Thanks for the follow-up and the postmortem notes. Mon/Tue were tight but Wed 8/19 still has a conflict for one of our engineers. Can we do Tue 8/18 at 14:00 PT instead? That works best for Samir and me.

Please include a calendar invite and any prep doc requests. We'll try to share our internal network diagram and a short list of firewall/IP ranges by EOD Monday.

See you then —
Talia
